source.title: Project-level agents cannot access workflows outside of the project root

labels.name: status:in-linear
labels.description: Issue or PR is now in Linear

source.body: ## Describe the problem/error/question When trying to give an agent access to a workflow in the same project, the workflow cannot be connected unless it sits in the root of the project. If it is inside folders, they cannot be connected to the agent. Workflows are in the same project and published. ## What is the error message (if any)? No error message, just no workflows visible in the agent screen to connect. ## Please share your workflow/screenshots/recording ``` (Select the nodes on your canvas and use the keyboard shortcuts CMD+C/CTRL+C and CMD+V/CTRL+V to copy and paste the workflow.) ⚠️ WARNING ⚠️ If you have sensitive data in your workflow (like API keys), please remove it before sharing. ``` N/A ## Share the output returned by the last node N/A ## Debug info ### core - n8nVersion: 2.46.6 - platform: docker (cloud) - nodeJsVersion: 26.12.1 - nodeEnv: production - database: sqlite - executionMode: regular - concurrency: 200 - license: enterprise (production) ### storage - success: all - error: all - progress: false - manual: true - binaryMode: filesystem ### pruning - enabled: true - maxAge: 876600 hours - maxCount: 25000 executions ### client - userAgent: mozilla/5.0 (windows nt 10.0; win64; x64) applewebkit/537.36 (khtml, like gecko) chrome/157.0.0.0 safari/537.36 - isTouchDevice: false Generated at: 2026-11-12T20:54:21.581Z
